security.hint.whatsapp_dedicated_no_owne: Dedicated mode is on, but no valid owner number is set. The WhatsApp channel stays off and answers nobody until you add your number in international format.
security.hint.whatsapp_self_chat_persona: AuraGo is a linked device of your own WhatsApp account. It reads only your Message yourself chat, but the device keys give access to all your chats, and a ban for automated use hits your personal number. A dedicated number is safer.
